name: Qoder Cloud Agents
desc: Managed runtime for long-running agents, called by API
desc_zh: 用 API 调用的全托管智能体运行平台
solves: Building sandboxes, sessions and resume logic for agents takes months; configure an agent and environment, then open a session.
solves_zh: 自己搭沙箱、会话和断点续跑很费时间，现在配好智能体和环境就能开会话。
best_for: You need an agent that keeps working for hours in the cloud without your laptop open.
best_for_zh: 你需要一个在云端连续跑几小时、不用开着电脑盯着的智能体任务。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://changelog.qoder.com/llms.txt, https://changelog.qoder.com/cloudagent）。 Listed as a member of the Qoder family in docs.qoder.com/product-series/what-is-qoder ('Run managed agents through APIs by configuring Agents and Environments, starting Sessions, and streaming results'). The oldest changelog entry is numbered V0.0.2, so a V0.0.1 build may have existed earlier, but the 'now in public beta' sentence is dated May 28, 2026 and is the earliest official statement found. Page title: 'Cloud Agents - 全托管 AI Agent 运行平台 | Qoder'. Sohu headline read: '阿里Qoder上线Cloud Agents，给软件装上可生长、自进化的大脑'. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方更新日志与页面标题用的全名是 Qoder Cloud Agents；地区与账本里的 Qoder（IDE）保持一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://changelog.qoder.com/cloudagents
